title: She Waited At The Window For 3 Years 🪟

scenes.narration: Every night at six, the white cat climbed into the window and waited.
scenes.image_prompt: a fluffy white cat with blue eyes sitting in an apartment window at dusk, city lights, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Six was when her boy came home from school. Until the day he didn't.
scenes.image_prompt: flashback of a young boy with a backpack hugging a fluffy white cat at the door, warm memory glow, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: His family moved across the country. The cat slipped out during the move, and was lost.
scenes.image_prompt: moving truck driving away down a street, fluffy white cat chasing it, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: A neighbor took her in. But every night, at six, she went back to the window.
scenes.image_prompt: fluffy white cat in a neighbor's window, staring at the street, seasons changing outside, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Three years later, a teenager knocked on the neighbor's door. He'd come back to visit his old street.
scenes.image_prompt: a teenage boy with the same face as before standing at a door, nervous, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Before he could say a word, a white blur leapt into his arms.
scenes.image_prompt: fluffy white cat leaping into the arms of a teenage boy, tears in his eyes, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: She never forgot what time he came home. Comment if your pet waits for you too.
scenes.image_prompt: teenage boy sitting in the window holding the fluffy white cat, sunset at six o'clock, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur
